targets.direct_cause_statement: The CPW response is generated only for the caption's approximate f0 and a reconstructed quality factor; the absolute geometry, phase velocity, coupling capacitors, and Q used for the illustrative line are not fixed.
targets.root_cause_statement: The legacy target did not freeze a normalized analytic-illustration contract before judging a source that has no unique device/port realization.
targets.next_discriminating_test: Freeze an explicit analytic CPW response contract, verify fm=(m+1)f0 and kappa_m=fm/Q pointwise, and retain the publication-input cap instead of fitting the source curve.

targets.direct_cause_statement: The missing case-local implementation has been repaired and isolated at reduced scale; paper-scale scientific acceptance or independent review is still outstanding.
targets.root_cause_statement: The remaining work is evidence closure at the declared scientific scale, not an unresolved implementation defect.
targets.next_discriminating_test: Run the declared paper profile where feasible and submit its outputs to fresh-context scientific review.

targets.direct_cause_statement: The former missing-parameter diagnosis was false: Fig. 25 prints chi, Omega_R, gamma_1, kappa, epsilon, and the cavity-drive conditions. The corrected clean-room runner consumes those values, but its analytic number-split model remains a paper subset pending fresh review.
targets.root_cause_statement: A legacy causal-classification and parameter-ingestion defect was repaired; the remaining boundary is scientific acceptance of the corrected caption-driven approximation.
targets.next_discriminating_test: Freshly review the corrected Poisson/master-equation approximation against the printed observable and promote only if the formula/parameter contract is equivalent.

targets.direct_cause_statement: The parameterized clean-room implementation for Fig. 26 cavity pull versus drive power executes, but the target paper does not publish figure_specific_cavity_linewidth, measurement_drive_frequency_or_detuning, steady_state_drive_to_photon_map.
targets.root_cause_statement: The target paper fixes the multilevel Hamiltonian parameters but not the figure-specific driven steady-state map from measurement drive power to intracavity photon number.
targets.next_discriminating_test: If the missing target-paper parameter deck becomes available, freeze it and rerun the unchanged clean-room entry point.

targets.direct_cause_statement: The parameterized clean-room implementation for Fig. 28 two- and three-level gate simulations executes, but the target paper does not publish decoherence_rates, pulse_width_schedule, randomized_benchmarking_error_map.
targets.root_cause_statement: The target paper delegates Fig. 28 to Chow et al. and does not publish the pulse schedule, decoherence fit, or RB-observable map needed for a point-for-point target-paper reconstruction.
targets.next_discriminating_test: If the missing target-paper parameter deck becomes available, freeze it and rerun the unchanged clean-room entry point.

targets.direct_cause_statement: The parameterized clean-room implementation for Fig. 4(b-e) rectangular cavity field modes executes, but the target paper does not publish comsol_material_and_boundary_deck, comsol_project_or_export, numerical_cavity_dimensions.
targets.root_cause_statement: The paper publishes mode labels and the ideal symbolic cavity equation, but not the numerical geometry or COMSOL project deck that generated the four declared field panels.
targets.next_discriminating_test: If the missing target-paper parameter deck becomes available, freeze it and rerun the unchanged clean-room entry point.

targets.direct_cause_statement: The previous runner incorrectly used chi as the cavity-drive detuning even though Fig. 25(b) drives on the pulled resonance. The corrected run yields mean photon number four and passes isolation, but fresh scientific review remains absent.
targets.root_cause_statement: A confirmed parameter-interpretation code defect was repaired; the remaining gap is independent validation of the number-split approximation.
targets.next_discriminating_test: Cross-check the corrected spectrum with an independently implemented driven-dispersive master equation at the caption parameters.

inventory.scope_reason: The archived preprint, formal paper, captions, sections, table, and appendices were read end to end. The source archive contains TeX and rendered figure PDFs but no author numerical code or arrays. Source figures were used only to enumerate displays and read printed labels, never to trace curves, fit untabulated parameters, or generate scientific data.
